page.overview:
What is Glamrock Freddy?

Glamrock Freddy is a major reoccurring animatronic in the Tales from the Pizzaplex series. He is the titular mascot and face of Freddy Fazbear's Mega Pizzaplex.

Glamrock Freddy is a large, anthropomorphic, orange and yellow animatronic bear wearing a black top hat and bow tie, which is encircled by a blue stripe, and wears spiked bracelets around his wrists and has a red earring on his left ear. He has a wide face with gleaming white eyes that glow, a massive toothy, friendly smile, red shoulder pads, and a turquoise lightning bolt on his chest.

A holographic Glamrock Freddy is displayed on a mini-projector in the AR Booth, greeting patrons to the Pizzaplex.

Freddy is mentioned to be walking around the Pizzaplex greeting children and is later seen on a Pizzaplex ad when at a bus stop.

Also known as: Glam Freddy.
